 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The USC women's basketball team returns to the court on Friday night at the Intuit Dome in Inglewood. This game against Baylor is the first one for USC since Sunday's loss to the No. 1-ranked South Carolina Gamecocks . It was a loss, but it was an encouraging performance for this very young and very talented USC team. South Carolina might be the best team the Trojans play all season long. USC would love to face South Carolina at the 2027 Women's Final Four in Columbus, Ohio. USC went to Greenville, South Carolina, playing in a pro-Gamecock arena against a team which has played in each of the last three national championship games. USC lost by only four points even though Saniyah Hall coughed up seven turnovers and Jazzy Davidson had a tough shooting day. USC played far from its best game but still took South Carolina down to the wire.
 This Baylor game will show us how much USC learned from the South Carolina game. USC has had several days off in which to apply lessons and study film. The hope is that we will see a sharper team, especially at the defensive end of the court. A strong performance here would give the Trojans confidence that they are on the right track.
